calculation: AFH-default natural-xenon isotope-specific halo-folded three-body differential rate
AFH_reference: Anand, Fitzpatrick and Haxton, Phys. Rev. C 89 (2014) 065501, arXiv:1308.6288; DMFormFactor v6.0 built-in sdgXeA default densities
abundance_source: NIST Atomic Weights and Isotopic Compositions for Xenon
abundance_convention: natural atomic fractions; no renormalization of the seven available isotopes
isotope_nuclear_mass_scheme: (NIST neutral-atom relative atomic mass - 54*m_e)*u; electronic binding energy neglected
width_scheme: pole width for chi2 -> chi1 s; conditional on Dirac chi2, real scalar, pure scalar off-diagonal Yukawa and no other open channels
native_Mathematica_validation: pending; response samples are from the source-translated AFH v6.0 table
response_q_status: exact spatial momentum transfer used by AFH response; consistent with exact nuclear mass-shell kinematics
response_q_followup: retain exact spatial q as baseline; q_NR=sqrt(2*m_A*E_R) is an optional small-recoil approximation for response-sensitivity comparison
response_q_reference_definition: AFH nuclear response variable y=(q*b_A/2)^2, where q is the spatial momentum transfer
response_sample_scope: seven AFH-default isotopes x four selected recoil energies; not the full 2401-point q grid
